name: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite
short: Google's cheapest 1M-context multimodal model ($0.10/$0.40, ~310 tok/s) for high-frequency tasks; Google Cloud retires it 2026-10-20 while the Gemini API keeps serving it.
modalities: Text, image, audio, video, PDF in; text out
freeTierNote: Free tier available on Google AI Studio with standard rate limits (NOT on OpenCode Zen: Zen's Gemini catalogue starts at Gemini 3 Flash and carries no Gemini 2.5 route)
standout: The cheapest 1M-context ticket in Google’s lineup at the time — built for high-frequency, small-payload automation.
tradeoff: The Google Cloud retirement is dated; the API tier lingers - migrate to Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
